_comment: Shared by tools/room/build.py (where each CRT goes) and src/crts.ts (where the camera stops). crts is one entry per station, in tour order: Work is the CRT that used to be MediaSafe's, Projects is the bench TV, About me is the CRT that used to be Contact's (the code matches a TV's place in crts to its station). spares are the three other CRTs: lit glass with no station, no card and no click. bakeOrder is the ids of all six TVs in the order tools/room/build.py bakes them, which is the order of their random draws (a sticky note's colour, a keyboard's tilt): keep it, or a re-bake redraws them. Site axes in metres: x across, y up, +z toward the door. yaw is the way a CRT faces, in degrees: 0 faces +z, 90 faces +x. keyboard: false leaves out the keyboard where there is no surface in front of the CRT. panel (site only, no re-bake) pins the station text to that point instead of the CRT, to keep the subject in view. portrait (site only) is how much further back the camera stands on a portrait window. phone (site only) replaces that with its own portrait stop: camera, look and panel pin, to bring lit parts of the room into a phone's frame. A spare's camera and look are only for build.py's --preview renders. overview (site only, no re-bake) is the camera, look and vertical field of view (fov, degrees; the stations use CAMERA_FOV) of the opening view of the room, with an exit point the flights leave it through, chosen so every station's glass is in frame at 16:9 and 16:10 and in front of the camera; overviewPortrait is its pose for a portrait window, a shot of the lit parts of the room.
